# Kapil Kumar Jangid — Full Stack Developer

> Portfolio site of Kapil Kumar Jangid, a Full Stack Developer and Open Source Contributor based in Rajasthan, India. Specializes in React, Next.js, TypeScript, and Node.js.

## About

Kapil Kumar Jangid is a self-taught full-stack developer who builds web apps, developer tools, mobile apps, and programming languages. He is passionate about open source and writing about what he builds.

- Location: Rajasthan, India
- Website: https://kapiljangid.pro
- GitHub: https://github.com/kjxcodez
- Twitter/X: https://twitter.com/kjxcodez

## Skills & Stack

- Languages: TypeScript, JavaScript, Dart, Python
- Frontend: React, Next.js, Tailwind CSS, Framer Motion
- Backend: Node.js, Express, Hono, Prisma, PostgreSQL, MongoDB
- Mobile: Flutter
- Tooling: Git, Docker, Vercel, Cloudflare

## Experience

- **RapidQuest** — Frontend Developer (intern/part-time)
  Worked on analytics dashboard and UI components using React and TypeScript.
